titulo: Orcas filmed ramming one of the world's heaviest fish so hard it explodes, possibly for fun
cuerpo: Orcas are known to be smart and ruthless hunters. They've been observed hunting a variety of prey, with some species, such as whales, larger than themselves. They use a wide range of strategies to hunt and kill prey, but now, in the Gulf of California, researchers have observed one that hasn't been described before.
